# Draftava 1.3.21
Draftava introduces a new file-first project format.
Your drafts and ideas are stored in a portable project folder.
## Upgrading an existing project
When Draftava opens, choose:
- **Migrate Existing V1 Project** to migrate your existing workspace. - **Choose V2 Project** to open an already prepared V2 project.
Migration creates a separate V2 folder and a verified backup of your original workspace.
Your original V1 workspace is not deleted or overwritten.
After migration, select the new V2 folder using **Choose V2 Project**.
The V2 project is stored inside **Draftava Projects** in iCloud Drive.
Drafts, ideas, groups, Archive, Trash, and saved Compare revisions are preserved.
